crown.zh: 又一双手，想接住这顶冠。
crown.en: Another pair of hands, reaching for the crown.
crown.performance: [quietly] Another pair of hands, [short pause] reaching for the crown.
crown.direction: 低沉、冷静地审视来者，句尾保留威严。

challenge.zh: 先让我看看……它们能承受多少。
challenge.en: First, let me see… how much they can bear.
challenge.performance: [serious] First, let me see... [lowered voice] how much they can bear.
challenge.direction: 从平静的审视转为带威胁的挑战，停顿后压低声音。

heavy.en: Let this war… teach you obeisance.
heavy.performance: [angry] Let this war... [shouts] teach you obeisance!
heavy.direction: 蓄力时低吼，后半句用有重量的命令语气。

roar.zh: 跪下！连死者都未曾获准起身！
roar.en: Kneel! Even the dead have not been granted leave to rise!
roar.performance: [shouts] Kneel! [angry] Even the dead have not been granted leave to rise!
roar.direction: 第一词爆发为战吼，后半句强硬而清晰。

player_fallen.zh: 又一位觊觎王冠的人……终于俯首。
player_fallen.en: Another claimant to the crown… bows at last.
player_fallen.performance: [coldly] Another claimant to the crown... [quietly] bows at last.
player_fallen.direction: 胜者的冷漠，略带蔑视，句尾收低。

warden_fallen.zh: 若你见到他们……就说，可以回家了。
warden_fallen.en: Should you find them… tell them they may go home.
warden_fallen.performance: [weary] Should you find them... [softly] tell them they may go home.
warden_fallen.direction: 濒死的疲惫，最后一句释然、温柔，不再威胁。
